risks: Root integration can change inspected bytes after this report; source hashes must be validated and changed seams re-inspected, not silently treated as tested input HEAD.
Adding a gateway handler without transport principal/action policy leaves forged actor/workspace and literal-owner authority gaps.
Current v2 status/receiptId response schema and Rox2CanonicalResult triad differ; implicit mapping can turn queued/ambiguous/fixture into healthy.
Static Docker/LiveKit health or cached readback is not current workspace-policy/config-bound capability; failure/expiry/revoke must invalidate and forbid join.
One healthy SFU receipt cannot prove egress, STT, sync, mail or final Page/media feature completeness.

SweepRetention is published in WP-52 despite WP-47 final retention scope; dropping it or globally flipping nativeDeleteAvailable violates acceptance. Ownership and authoritative manifests/legal holds need integration before claims.
Full completeness lists cross-surface consumers with no domain touchpoints/renderer/API-MCP seam in the package record; they remain pending, not N/A.
WP-52 copied WP-47 runner/private marker and optional sandbox wording can produce a wrong-package pass or dependency cycle if left unchanged.
Provider credentials, endpoint trust, exact license/version selection and NAT/TURN environment vary and were not inspected or probed in this preflight.
Provider create/delete timeouts may leave real objects/rooms; command receipt must preserve unknown effects and reconcile cleanup before repeating.
Backlog alert needs real durable queued work and threshold/sink receipt; budget ledger counters or YAML parsing cannot prove it.
Compose/env/livekit are shared with WP-47; independent duplicate writers/topologies would violate canonical deployment ownership.
